entries.title: APE OUT

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has native PC capture/settings flexibility, current Steam/GOG availability, and no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content is documented for the Switch or macOS releases.
primary.how_to_play: Buy APE OUT on Steam or GOG for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or separate edition is documented.
